archetype: 3 (Pastel & Soft) / 4 (Swiss) Hybrid - The 'Soft Utility' Linear Vibe

design_philosophy.identity: Minimalist, structural clarity over decoration. Clean soft UI with card-based, rounded components. A neutral light gray/white base paired with an energetic Orange accent. Uses purposeful negative space to reduce cognitive load.
rules: Use optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
Never use Inter or generic sans for headings.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
Use purely functional colors for charts and statuses.
Embrace 'Control Room' bento grid for the dashboard with tight gaps (gap-4/gap-6).

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Strictly implement a fixed Sidebar + Topbar layout. The main content should scroll within its container, avoiding whole-page window scrolls if possible.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: For the Donut Chart (Projects Overview), use Shadcn chart components with subtle colors.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: The 'AI Insights' card MUST stand out slightly from standard cards using a very faint orange gradient background (bg-gradient-to-br from-orange-50 to-white) and an orange-tinted border.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Avatars for the 'Open Tickets' list MUST utilize the URLs provided in the media object. DO NOT USE placeholder text.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Horizontal Progress Bars for the 'Task Progress Overview' should stack or list clearly, using Tailwind classes like h-2, rounded-full, and the respective status colors defined in the guideline.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Install the required fonts: Google Fonts 'Manrope' and 'Inter'. Apply Manrope strictly for headings, Inter for body text.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: All core interactive elements (buttons, nav links, tabs) must have data-testid attributes for testing.
